title.suggested: Sewer collapse postpones Tom Allen's benefit

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Tom Allen's benefit at the Theater Comique, where he was to receive a $1,000 championship belt, was postponed to Wednesday after the Biddle Street sewer caved in out front before the show began.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Daily Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 1, 1870. The event was Saturday night, April 30.

facts.fact: A pugilistic benefit for Allen at the Theater Comique (old Mozart Hall), St. Louis, where he was to be presented with a $1,000 championship belt and spar with Joe Coburn and Mike McCoole, was postponed to Wednesday when the Biddle Street sewer caved in before the show
places: Theater Comique (old Mozart Hall), Biddle Street, St. Louis

notes: Existing fact 021 dates the belt presentation to April 29, 1870; this article shows it was planned for Saturday April 30 and then postponed to Wednesday (May 4).
